name: Bauernhof Madlerbauer
beschreibung: The Madlerbauer farm in Ebbs is a traditional Tiroler inn with its own farm. The rooms are cozily and functionally furnished and offer views of the greenery. The dining room serves seasonal dishes with ingredients from the farm itself. The quiet location in nature allows relaxation and walks directly from the accommodation. The village of Ebbs is near the town of Kufstein and is a good starting point for tours in the Kaisergebirge. Hikes and ski trips in the surrounding area are easily reachable from the farm.
